holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit increased to Rs 16,276 crore in the quarter ended June 2026 from Rs 15,681 crore in March 2026.
The board scheduled a meeting for October 17, 2026 to consider Q2 FY27 financial results.
Regulatory scrutiny from IRDAI over bancassurance and insurance payouts created sector-wide headwinds for private banks.

holdings.why_it_matters: ICICI Bank is the fund's largest position at 7.02% weight. Its 3-month return of -4.22% created an estimated drag of -0.296% on portfolio performance.

watch.text: Q2 FY27 earnings approval scheduled for October 17, 2026.

holdings.name: HDFC Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit stood at Rs 20,383 crore for the quarter ended June 2026 versus Rs 21,074 crore in March 2026.
RBI commenced review of CEO succession nominees, with Anup Bagchi and Kaizad Bharucha under evaluation.
The board scheduled an October 17, 2026 meeting to approve Q2 FY27 results.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 5.55% fund weight, HDFC Bank's -7.92% 3-month return detracted an estimated -0.44% from returns, compounding weakness across the 30.6% Financials sector.

watch.text: RBI's final approval on the CEO succession within 7 to 10 days.
Board review of quarterly results on October 17, 2026.

holdings.name: Bharti Airtel Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit expanded to Rs 10,012 crore in June 2026 from Rs 9,247 crore in March 2026.
Bharti Airtel bundled Apple iCloud+, Apple TV, and Apple Arcade into its ₹999 and higher family postpaid plans.
DoT and TRAI issued penalties totaling over Rs 3.6 lakh for subscriber verification norms and quality-of-service compliance.

holdings.why_it_matters: Airtel represents 4.26% of the portfolio and anchors the fund's 13.1% Technology sector allocation. Its 3-month decline of -3.32% dampened broader technology contributions.

watch.text: TRAI's inquiry regarding mobile number portability rule violation allegations.

holdings.name: Bajaj Finance Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit for June 2026 rose to Rs 6,081 crore while gross NPA reduced to 0.96%.
The board scheduled a meeting on October 1, 2026 to deliberate on raising capital via a preferential issue or QIP.
Shares faced selling pressure after IRDAI flagged elevated insurance commission payouts.

holdings.why_it_matters: Weighing 3.42%, Bajaj Finance is the largest NBFC holding in the fund. Its flat 3-month return (+0.58%) cushioned the portfolio against sharper private bank drawdowns.

watch.text: Outcome of the board meeting on October 1, 2026 concerning capital raising plans.

holdings.name: Zomato Ltd

what_changed.text: Revenue grew to Rs 20,211 crore in June 2026 with an operating profit margin of 2.9%.
The platform introduced a new pay-on-delivery surcharge.
Assisted more than 2 lakh delivery partners in filing income tax returns for FY25-26.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 3.24% weight, Zomato was the second-highest contributor over 3 months, generating an estimated +0.976% gain on the back of a 30.12% stock price rise.

watch.text: Competitive intensity in quick commerce against Swiggy over the medium term.

holdings.name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit declined quarter-on-quarter to Rs 4,988 crore in June 2026 from Rs 6,133 crore in March 2026.
L&T Semiconductor unveiled 40 products including silicon carbide chips at SEMICON 2026.
Secured an offshore EPCIC order from ONGC.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 2.90% weight within the 12.8% Industrials basket, L&T's 3-month decline of -8.61% took an estimated -0.25% off fund returns.

watch.text: Execution milestones on the offshore EPCIC project for ONGC.

holdings.name: Divi's Laboratories Ltd

what_changed.text: Operating profit margin expanded to 41% in June 2026, driving quarterly net profit to Rs 902 crore.
Citi reaffirmed a Buy rating with a Rs 11,700 price target based on oral Wegovy commercial potential.
Shareholders approved an annual dividend of Rs 30 per share at the August AGM.

holdings.why_it_matters: Divi's was the fund's top 3-month contributor, adding an estimated +1.165% to performance through a 42.98% return at a 2.71% fund weight.

watch.text: Supply chain progress and demand traction relating to oral Wegovy opportunities.

holdings.name: Axis Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit reached Rs 7,670 crore in June 2026, up from Rs 7,642 crore in the prior quarter.
Appointed Arvind Subramanian as an additional independent director for a four-year term.
Fee income faced headwinds following IRDAI concerns over excessive insurance distributor payouts.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 2.63% weight, Axis Bank's -12.08% 3-month drop detracted an estimated -0.318% from the fund, leading sector-wide underperformance.

watch.text: Upcoming Q2 FY27 results declaration and earnings call details.
Regulatory actions regarding bancassurance fee compression.

holdings.name: Pidilite Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: Quarterly net profit reached Rs 884 crore in June 2026 on revenue of Rs 4,552 crore.
Completed voluntary liquidation of dormant Bangladesh step-down subsidiary NPBPL.

expected.text: Management expects Q2 demand to hold steady and ruled out immediate price hikes.

holdings.why_it_matters: Accounting for 2.62% of the fund in Materials, Pidilite's -5.84% 3-month return mirrors margin uncertainties tied to raw material inputs.

watch.text: Crude oil volatility toward $100 per barrel as flagged by management.

holdings.name: Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit increased to Rs 5,998 crore in June 2026 from Rs 5,260 crore in March 2026.
Managing Director Dr. Anish Shah sold 76,357 equity shares to cover ESOP tax obligations.
Subsidiary Mahindra Finance approved a ₹2,000 crore non-convertible debenture issuance.

expected.text: Company expects Thar and Thar Roxx sales volumes to grow by at least 10% over the next 12 months.

holdings.why_it_matters: M&M holds 2.57% in Consumer Discretionary. A -5.32% 3-month return and -11.34% 1-month fall added to fund drag despite revenue growth.

watch.text: Volume deliveries for Thar and Thar Roxx against the 10% growth expectation.

portfolio.statement: Significant drag from major banking holdings was partially counterbalanced by strong gains in healthcare and platform technology.
interp: Top contributors Divi's Laboratories (+1.165% estimated contribution) and Zomato (+0.976%) helped limit portfolio losses over 3 months.
Heavy allocation to Financials (30.6%), particularly HDFC Bank, Axis Bank, and ICICI Bank, led the fund's 3-month return to -0.30%.
portfolio.line: ELSS fund navigating heavy banking headwinds balanced by selective healthcare and internet momentum.

drivers.text: Divi's Laboratories surged 42.98% over 3 months, contributing +1.165% to fund returns.
Zomato climbed 30.12% over 3 months, adding an estimated +0.976% contribution.
HDFC Bank fell -7.92% over 3 months amid leadership succession uncertainty, creating a -0.44% drag.
Axis Bank slid -12.08% over 3 months as IRDAI regulatory scrutiny hit insurance fee expectations.

themes.title: Bancassurance Regulatory Friction
themes.text: IRDAI regulatory scrutiny over insurance commissions and distributor payouts pressured non-interest fee income expectations across private lenders.

themes.title: Platform and Specialized Manufacturing Growth
themes.text: Strong execution in active pharmaceutical ingredients and consumer quick commerce delivered resilient earnings and sharp market outperformance.

macro.why: IRDAI clampdown on distributor payouts and commissions threatens fee revenues for major retail banks and non-bank lenders.
Fluctuations in crude oil toward $100 per barrel pose margin risks for chemical and adhesive manufacturing input costs.

priced_in.text: Leadership succession uncertainty at HDFC Bank following months of leadership transition scrutiny.
Earnings boost and margin expansion at Divi's Laboratories related to oral Wegovy opportunities.

could_change.title: Resolution of HDFC Bank CEO Selection
could_change.text: An official RBI decision regarding the CEO post could remove governance overhang and stabilize the fund's second-largest holding.

could_change.title: Final IRDAI Directives on Payouts
could_change.text: Clarity on insurance commission guidelines will determine the medium-term impact on banking fee income.

portfolio.risk_note: A 30.6% sector concentration in Financials makes the fund highly sensitive to bancassurance regulatory changes and lending margin compression.
